hero.lead: Fikisha connects businesses in Kitengela and the surrounding area with verified local transport operators — from a motorcycle parcel to a full trailer load.
hero.signInNote: New to Fikisha? Signing in with your phone number creates your account automatically.

how.title: How it works
how.body: We digitise how the network already works — stages and yards, direct contact, prices negotiated between the parties, and disputes settled amicably first — with a shared, auditable record from pickup to delivery.

business.title: Moving goods?
business.body: Post what you need moved, agree a price directly with an operator, and follow the job through to delivery.

operator.title: Driving for work?
operator.body: Find loads near your stage, negotiate your own price, and build a trusted record as you complete jobs.

footer.signIn: Sign in with your phone number
